# dlaqsb

> Equilibrates a symmetric band matrix using the scaling factors in the vector S.

<section class="usage">

## Usage

```js
import dlaqsb from '@rreusser/blahpack/lapack/base/dlaqsb';
```

### Layout API

Takes a storage layout (`order`) and leading dimensions, like CBLAS/LAPACKE.

```js
dlaqsb( order, uplo, N, KD, AB, LDAB, S, strideS, scond, amax, equed ) → Float64Array
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `order` | `Layout` | Storage layout ('row-major' or 'column-major') |
| `uplo` | `MatrixTriangle` | `'upper'` or `'lower'` |
| `N` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Order of the matrix A |
| `KD` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Number of super-diagonals (upper) or sub-diagonals (lower) |
| `AB` | `Float64Array`<br><sub>(kd + 1) × N</sub> | **in/out** · Band matrix, dimension (LDAB, N) |
| ↳ `LDAB` | `PositiveInteger` | Leading dimension of AB |
| `S` | `Float64Array`<br><sub>length N</sub> | Scaling factors, length N |
| ↳ `strideS` | `integer` | Stride for S |
| `scond` | `number` | Ratio of smallest to largest scaling factor |
| `amax` | `number` | Absolute value of largest matrix element |
| `equed` | `Array.<string>` | **out** · Specifies whether or not equilibration was done. `'none'`: No equilibration. `'yes'`: Equilibration was done, i.e., A has been replaced by diag(S) \* A \* diag(S). |

<details>
<summary>Reference notes for each argument (the reference implementation's own documentation; 1-based indices)</summary>

- `uplo`: Specifies whether the upper or lower triangular part of the symmetric matrix A is stored.

  -   `= 'U'`: Upper triangular
  -   `= 'L'`: Lower triangular
- `N`: The order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.
- `KD`: The number of super-diagonals of the matrix A if `UPLO = 'U'`, or the number of sub-diagonals if `UPLO = 'L'`. $\mathrm{KD} \ge 0$.
- `AB`: On entry, the upper or lower triangle of the symmetric band matrix A, stored in the first `KD`+1 rows of the array. The j-th column of A is stored in the j-th column of the array `AB` as follows: if `UPLO = 'U'`, `AB(kd+1+i-j,j) = A(i,j)` for $\max (1,j-\mathrm{kd}) \le i \le j$; if `UPLO = 'L'`, `AB(1+i-j,j) = A(i,j)` for $j \le i \le \min (n,j+\mathrm{kd})$.

  On exit, if $\mathrm{INFO} = 0$, the triangular factor U or L from the Cholesky factorization $A = U^T \, U$ or $A = L \, L^T$ of the band matrix A, in the same storage format as A.
- `S`: The scale factors for A.
- `scond`: Ratio of the smallest `S(i)` to the largest `S(i)`.
- `amax`: Absolute value of largest matrix entry.
- `equed`: Specifies whether or not equilibration was done.

  -   `= 'N'`: No equilibration.
  -   `= 'Y'`: Equilibration was done, i.e., A has been replaced by $\operatorname{diag}(S) \, A \, \operatorname{diag}(S)$.

</details>

**Returns** `Float64Array`: `AB`

**Throws**

- `TypeError` first argument must be a valid order
- `TypeError` second argument must be a valid matrix triangle
- `RangeError` sixth argument must be greater than or equal to `max( 1, N )` (row-major)
- `RangeError` sixth argument must be greater than or equal to `max( 1, KD + 1 )` (column-major)

### Strided (ndarray) API

Takes explicit strides and offsets for every array. Use it for views, sub-matrices and non-unit strides.

```js
dlaqsb.ndarray(
    uplo,
    N, kd,
    AB, strideAB1, strideAB2, offsetAB,
    S, strideS, offsetS,
    scond, amax,
    equed
) → Float64Array
```

Matrix shapes are logical (rows × columns). The reference's leading dimension (`LDA`, …) is replaced by the two strides and the offset.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `uplo` | `MatrixTriangle` | `'upper'` or `'lower'` |
| `N` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Order of the matrix A |
| `kd` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Number of super-diagonals (upper) or sub-diagonals (lower) |
| `AB` | `Float64Array`<br><sub>(kd + 1) × N</sub> | **in/out** · Input/output band matrix, dimension (LDAB, N) |
| ↳ `strideAB1` | `integer` | Stride of the first dimension of `AB` |
| ↳ `strideAB2` | `integer` | Stride of the second dimension of `AB` |
| ↳ `offsetAB` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Starting index for `AB` |
| `S` | `Float64Array`<br><sub>length N</sub> | Scaling factors, length N |
| ↳ `strideS` | `integer` | Stride length for `S` |
| ↳ `offsetS` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Starting index for `S` |
| `scond` | `number` | Ratio of smallest to largest scaling factor |
| `amax` | `number` | Absolute value of largest matrix element |
| `equed` | `Array.<string>` | **out** · Specifies whether or not equilibration was done. `'none'`: No equilibration. `'yes'`: Equilibration was done, i.e., A has been replaced by diag(S) \* A \* diag(S). |

<details>
<summary>Reference notes for each argument (the reference implementation's own documentation; 1-based indices)</summary>

- `uplo`: Specifies whether the upper or lower triangular part of the symmetric matrix A is stored.

  -   `= 'U'`: Upper triangular
  -   `= 'L'`: Lower triangular
- `N`: The order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.
- `kd`: The number of super-diagonals of the matrix A if `UPLO = 'U'`, or the number of sub-diagonals if `UPLO = 'L'`. $\mathrm{KD} \ge 0$.
- `AB`: On entry, the upper or lower triangle of the symmetric band matrix A, stored in the first `KD`+1 rows of the array. The j-th column of A is stored in the j-th column of the array `AB` as follows: if `UPLO = 'U'`, `AB(kd+1+i-j,j) = A(i,j)` for $\max (1,j-\mathrm{kd}) \le i \le j$; if `UPLO = 'L'`, `AB(1+i-j,j) = A(i,j)` for $j \le i \le \min (n,j+\mathrm{kd})$.

  On exit, if $\mathrm{INFO} = 0$, the triangular factor U or L from the Cholesky factorization $A = U^T \, U$ or $A = L \, L^T$ of the band matrix A, in the same storage format as A.
- `S`: The scale factors for A.
- `scond`: Ratio of the smallest `S(i)` to the largest `S(i)`.
- `amax`: Absolute value of largest matrix entry.
- `equed`: Specifies whether or not equilibration was done.

  -   `= 'N'`: No equilibration.
  -   `= 'Y'`: Equilibration was done, i.e., A has been replaced by $\operatorname{diag}(S) \, A \, \operatorname{diag}(S)$.

</details>

**Returns** `Float64Array`: `AB`

**Throws**

- `TypeError` first argument must be a valid matrix triangle

<section class="notes">

## Notes

-   `dlaqsb()` corresponds to the reference LAPACK routine [`DLAQSB`](https://github.com/Reference-LAPACK/lapack/blob/v3.12.0/SRC/dlaqsb.f).

</section>

<!-- /.notes -->

<section class="examples">

## Examples

```js
import Float64Array from '@stdlib/array/float64/lib/index.js';
import dlaqsb from '@rreusser/blahpack/lapack/base/dlaqsb';

// 4x4 symmetric band matrix (upper, KD=1, LDAB=2):
const AB = new Float64Array( [ 0.0, 4.0, 1.0, 9.0, 2.0, 16.0, 3.0, 25.0 ] ); // eslint-disable-line max-len
const S = new Float64Array( [ 0.5, 0.25, 0.2, 0.1 ] );

// Poor scond triggers equilibration:
const equed = [ '' ];
dlaqsb.ndarray( 'upper', 4, 1, AB, 1, 2, 0, S, 1, 0, 0.02, 25.0, equed );

console.log( 'equed:', equed[ 0 ] ); // eslint-disable-line no-console
// => 'yes'

console.log( 'AB:', AB ); // eslint-disable-line no-console
```

</section>
